title: Export the scenario scorer (scoreGraph / scoreGraphShape / deriveShape / artifactToEvalGraph / gradeRun) from a published entry so cloud can drop its drifting copy
body:
epic:#3600#1 · hotlong · session_01Q4EjjPXwX1YfHyKJUh4agu

Filing-gate category: ④ coordination child, the objectstack half of objectstack-ai/cloud#3604 (the cloud evals import the open scenario scorer). It is filed now because its trigger condition landed: #30290 merged as `31d23c3f` (PR #30332). Maintainer ruling it carries, on objectstack-ai/cloud#3600 (D2): 「打分器可以迁移到开源项目」.

## Problem

The deterministic scenario scorer now lives in `packages/cli/src/lint/` (`scenario-score.ts`, `scenario-graph.ts`, `scenario-run-grade.ts`). PR #30332 deliberately added **no package-entry export**: it measured `Clause-②: no` with 0 of 39 declaration files under `dist/lint`. So cloud, which consumes the framework through its `.objectstack-sha` pin, has no import path. Cloud therefore keeps its private copy, `packages/service-ai-studio/src/evals/structural-score.ts`, with the two blind spots #30332 measured and closed (a nav target "exists" without any app navigating to it; a widget bound to a missing dataset passes its measure check).

## Ask

Expose the scorer through a published entry of `@objectstack/cli`, or of a more fitting published package if the lane measures one. Precedent for a subpath: `./hook-body` in `packages/cli/package.json` `exports`.
- Cloud must be able to import `scoreGraph`, `scoreGraphShape`, `deriveShape`, `artifactToEvalGraph` and `gradeRun`, with their types.
- This **widens a public surface**, so it is `Clause-②: yes` and owes the contract review the spec lane gives a widening.
- The exported names are a contract from then on. Keep the set to what cloud#3604 consumes.

## Acceptance

- The entry's declaration closure carries the five functions and their types (a positive control in the PR).
- cloud#3604 can then drop its copy once the pin moves.

Suggested lane: `domain:spec` reviews the widening; the code lands in `packages/cli`. Routing is triage's.

Dedup: "scenario scorer" in this repo → 3 hits (#30290, #30291, #30274), none an export card; "scoreGraphShape" → 1 (#30290).
